thread:
Lena (growth): Quick ask 1 — need a compact asset pack for the webinar next Wed. Must include: hero slide (2 headline variants), three metric cards (Latency / Cost / Reliability), social crop sizes, and a one-slide lead-routing diagram. Low-fi OK.

Riley (design-ops): I can take this. Deliver first PNG comps + Figma frames in 24-36h. Motion layers as separate groups if needed for GIF. What copy do we want on the cards?

Marco (product-marketing): Draft copy: Latency: "p95 latency about 20ms (typical)"; Cost: "Unit cost roughly $0.10 / 1k tokens (typical)"; Reliability: "Target SLA 99.9%". Hero headlines: A) "Cut inference cost without sacrificing latency" B) "Predictable latency for production LLMs"

Sam (demand-gen): Social sizes: IG 1080x1080, LinkedIn 1200x627, Twitter 1200x675. Paid needs muted BG + white overlay. GIF max 2s.

Legal Bot: Use qualifiers ("typical", "about"). Avoid dollar guarantees. Required gated form language: "By registering you agree to receive communications from Redwood Inference. See https://redwood.com/privacy."

Ishaan (ops): For routing slide: gated -> work_email? yes -> enterprise_queue else inbound_queue. Notify #leads-webinar and ops@redwood.com. Include CSV export note: timestamp,email,company,company_size,route_tag.

Riley (design-ops): Noted. Following brand tokens: primary #0A74FF, accent #0B6FD8, bg #F4F7FB. Accessibility: contrast >=4.5. I'll provide dark-mode variants and alt text file (EN/FR/DE).

Lena (growth): Please include short subheads (<=25 chars) for social overlays and an animated tile flip for paid if time. Owners: Riley design, Marco copy, Sam paid, Ishaan routing, Legal Bot signoff.

Riley (design-ops): Will drop frames in Figma under /marketing/launch and ping this thread when ready. Checklist: hero (1920x1080) x2, tiles (1080x1080 + 1200x627), social exports, routing slide (PNG + PPTX), optional GIF, alt text + localization.

Marco (product-marketing): I'll post final microcopy in thread by EOD. Thanks everyone.
